faqs.q: How can I establish water and sewer service?
faqs.a: New Home Owners: If you are a new homeowner here in Arvada, the title company you worked with during the purchase of your home will contact the City of Arvada to set up water / sewer service in your name. Renters: If you are a renter, your landlord will contact the City of Arvada to set up water/sewer service in your name.
